Keep in mind that you can only capture skills from a boss of the same primary or secondary profession as yourself.}} The [[Signet of Capture]] is a [[skill]] used to capture skills from dead [[boss]]es. == Acquisition == ; [[Skill quest]]s * [[Prophecies]] ** [[Malaquire's Test]] ([[Lion's Arch]]) * [[Factions]] ** [[Minister's Test]] ([[Kaineng Center]]) * [[Nightfall]] ** [[Capturing the Signet of Capture]] ([[Marga Coast]]) ; [[Skill trainer]]s * [[Core]] ** [[Skill Trainer (NPC)|Skill Trainer]] (the [[guild hall]] skill trainer will sell this skill to any [[character]], even if they have not completed any of the quests above) * Prophecies ** Any from [[Lion's Arch]] onward * Factions ** Any on the [[Cantha]]n mainland * Nightfall ** Any from [[Yohlon Haven]] onward * [[Eye of the North]] ** Any skill trainer {{anomaly|The skill trainers in [[Lion's Arch]], [[Camp Rankor]], [[Vasburg Armory]], and [[Ascalon Settlement]] in [[North Kryta Province]] do not sell this skill. [[Tyrian]] ([[Prophecies]]) characters can purchase a Signet of Capture in Lion's Arch from [[Magi Malaquire]].}} == Capturing skills == The following steps allow a player to capture a skill using the Signet: # Obtain the signet and add it to the character's skill bar. # Kill [[list of elite skills by capture location|an appropriate boss]]. # Activate the signet (while in the boss' vicinity) # From the skill-pick window, select one of the available skills and press the ''capture'' button. # The Signet will be replaced with the new skill. # When you return to an outpost, you will have one less capture signet available in the skills panel. === Capture notes === * The skill-pick window will show skills from all bosses within range that belong to the character's primary [[profession]] and current secondary. It will not show two types of skills: ** Those from the other eight professions. ** [[Monster skill]]s * The capture button will be greyed out and prevent capturing two types of skills: ** Already known skills, i.e. you cannot re-capture a skill. ** Skills from [[campaign]]s not yet linked to the [[account]]. * Signets are typically used to capture [[elite skill]]s, but they can be used for other skills, too: ** Some ordinary skills can be obtained sooner via capturing than through a skill trainer; these are noted on the relevant skill's wiki article. == Notes == * Each time a character learns a new elite, they gain another point of progress in the relevant [[Skill Hunter]] [[title]] track. * Unlike other skills, it is possible to obtain multiple copies of Signet of Capture. * This skill counts as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE skill]]: ** It cannot be equipped for [[PvP]] or by [[hero]]es. ** You can equip up to three copies of this signet on your skill bar. ** Although this allows you to have multiple elites after capturing, when you [[zone]], you will be left with only one elite. *** The game will drop any ''extra'' elites on the left side of the skill bar. *** You may rearrange your skills so that the skill you wish to keep is on the right before you zone. * This skill cannot be [[Echo]]ed, [[unlock]]ed, or learned by using a [[skill tome]]. * [[fleshy|Non-fleshy]] bosses leave a spot on the ground rather than a visible [[corpse]]. {{anomaly|Signet of Capture's actual [[range]] is larger than [[earshot]].}} === Dialogue (if no skills for your professions) === : No valid skills were found. You can only capture skills that correspond to your profession. == Trivia == * This skill was once intended to be called "Signet of Attainment". * Prior to the [[Game updates/20050608|June 8th, 2005 update]], this skill had to be activated at the same time the [[target]]ed boss activated the desired skill. * The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Signet_of_Capture/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
